div.l: His lorde he couthe . plesen subtily .
To yeue ⁊and lene . hym his owne good .
And haue a thanke . ⁊and yet a coote ⁊and an hood .
In yougthe he had lerned . a good mystere .
He was a well good wright . a Carpyntere .
This Reue . sat vp on a full good stoot .
That was all pomely grey . ⁊and hight scoot .
A longe surcote . of peers blewe he had .
And bi his side . he bar / a rusti blad .
Of northfolk . was this Reue . of whiche I telle .
Beside a towne . men clepe Baldiswelle .
Tukked he was . as is a frere a boute .
Anddd euer he rood . the hynderist of oure route .
A Sompnorur was there . wiþ vs in that place .
That had . a firy reed cherubynnes face .
For sawceflem he was . with eyen narowe .
And as hoot he was . ⁊and lecherous as a sparowe .
With skallid browis . blaak ⁊and pelid berde .
Of his visage . children weren afferde .
Ther was no quyk siluer / . litarge . nor brymston .
Brace Ceruce . ne oile of tarter / non .
Ne oynement . that wolde clense ⁊and byte .
That hym myght helpe . of his whelkes white .
Nor of the knobbes . sittyng in his chekes .
Well loued he garlik . oynons ⁊and lekes .
And for to drynke . strong wyne . reed as blood .
Than wolde he speke ⁊and crie as he were wood .
For whan that he . well dronken had the wyn .
Than wolde he speke no worde . but latyn .
A fewe termes had he . two or thre .
That he had lerned . oute of som decre .
No wondyr is . he herde it all the daye .
And eke ye knowen well . how that a Iaye .
Can klepe watte . as well as can the pope .
But who so couthe . in other thynges grope
Than had he . spende . all his philosophie .
Ay questio quid iuris wolde he crye .
He was a gentill harlot . ⁊and a kynde .
A bettir / felawe . schulde men not fynde
He wolde suffre . for a quarte of wyn .
A good felawe . to haue a concubyn .
A twelf monthe . ⁊and excuse hym atte fulle .
Full pryuely eke . a fynche couthe he pulle .
And if he fonde . owher a good felawe .
He wolde techen hym . to haue non awe .
In suche caas . of the Erchedekens curs .
But if a mannes soule . were in his purs . /
